cues: Haloalkanes are classified by the carbon that carries the halogen.
If that carbon is joined to one other carbon, it is primary.
It decides the mechanism: primary halides react by S N two, tertiary ones by S N one.
text: Haloalkanes are classified by the carbon that carries the halogen. If that carbon is joined to one other carbon, it is primary. Two others, secondary. Three, tertiary. This is not just bookkeeping. It decides the mechanism: primary halides react by S N two, tertiary ones by S N one.
